Robot gets decapitated in a fight and doesn't even flinch
caption:
A fighting robot got its head completely ripped off in the ring and kept attacking like nothing happened.

These aren't your old remote control cars crashing into walls. Today's combat robots are built tough enough that losing a whole body part won't shut them down. This one proved it by refusing to quit even after getting decapitated mid-fight.
